customFlutter.title: Custom Flutter Development
customFlutter.description: From concept to deployment, we build custom Flutter applications tailored to your business needs.
details: We work with you from the first idea through design, development, and publishing. Every app is built with clean architecture, scalable state management, and a focus on performance and maintainability.
Whether you need a consumer app, B2B tool, or internal platform, we deliver production-ready code and clear documentation so your team can own and extend the product long term.

maintenance.title: App Maintenance & Support
maintenance.description: Keep your app running smoothly with regular updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.
details: Ongoing support prevents small issues from becoming costly problems and keeps your app aligned with the latest OS and dependency updates. We offer flexible plans—from ad-hoc fixes to dedicated monthly retainer—so you can choose the level that fits your budget and roadmap.
Our team handles dependency upgrades, security patches, and performance tuning, and we can add new features or refactor existing code as your requirements evolve.

consulting.title: Consulting & Strategy
consulting.description: Expert guidance on Flutter architecture, best practices, and development strategy.
details: We help teams and stakeholders make informed decisions about stack, architecture, and roadmap. Whether you're starting a new Flutter project, refactoring an existing app, or evaluating Flutter for your organization, we provide clear, actionable recommendations.
Sessions can cover architecture review, code audits, performance profiling, team onboarding to Flutter, or a phased development roadmap with milestones and estimates.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Learn more about RGsoft, how we work, and what we offer.
faq.whatIsRGsoftAnswer: RGsoft is a development agency based in Skopje, North Macedonia, founded in 2022. We build mobile apps, responsive websites, and web applications—and offer consulting and support from idea to launch and beyond. We use modern tools like Flutter and focus on clear communication, quality, and delivery you can rely on.
faq.howRGsoftWorksAnswer: We work in clear phases: we start by understanding your goals and scope, then move through design, development, testing, and deployment. You get regular updates and milestones so the project stays on track. We use a single codebase where possible (e.g. Flutter for iOS and Android) to keep costs and timelines under control while delivering native-quality results.
faq.whatDoesRGsoftOfferAnswer: We offer app development (cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter), website development (landing pages, responsive sites, web apps), design (UI/UX, logos, store assets), maintenance and support, and consulting. You can hire us for one project or ongoing work—we adapt to your needs.
faq.whoIsRGsoftForAnswer: We work with startups, small and medium businesses, and larger organizations that need a professional app, website, or both. Whether you have a clear brief or just an idea, we help you shape the product and deliver it. Our pricing is competitive and we're used to working with teams that want quality without agency-level overhead.
faq.howToGetStartedQuestion: How do I get started with RGsoft?
faq.howToGetStartedAnswer: Reach out via the contact link or email in the footer. Tell us about your project—app, website, or both—and what you want to achieve. We'll discuss scope, timeline, and pricing and send you a proposal. No obligation; we're happy to answer questions before you commit.
faq.whereIsRGsoftAnswer: We're based in Skopje, North Macedonia. We work with clients locally and internationally. Most collaboration happens remotely (calls, chat, shared docs), so your location doesn't need to match ours.
faq.pricingOverviewAnswer: Pricing depends on the project. For websites, a simple landing page can start from around $150 and go up with complexity. For apps, a simple MVP can start from around $500. For detailed pricing and packages, see our App Development and Website Development pages—each has its own FAQ with pricing and scope details.

faqApp.title: App Development FAQ
faqApp.description: Questions and answers about our app development services and pricing.
faqApp.whatIsFlutterAnswer: Cross-platform development means one app that runs on iOS and Android from a single codebase. We use Flutter so you get native-quality performance, one codebase to maintain, and lower cost and time than building two separate apps.
faqApp.processQuestion: What does your app development process look like?
faqApp.processAnswer: We start with your goals and scope, then move through design, development, testing, and deployment. We use clean architecture and modern state management, and you get clear milestones and regular updates. Many projects are delivered in phases so you can launch an MVP first and add features over time.
faqApp.howLongQuestion: How long does an app project take?
faqApp.howLongAnswer: A simple MVP might take a few weeks; a full product with custom features can take several months. We give you an estimate after discussing your requirements and can often phase delivery so you get a first version live sooner.
faqApp.maintenanceQuestion: Do you offer app maintenance and support?
faqApp.maintenanceAnswer: Yes. We offer updates, bug fixes, security patches, and new features. Plans range from ad-hoc fixes to monthly retainers so you can choose what fits your budget and roadmap.
faqApp.appPricingQuestion: How much does app development cost?
faqApp.appPricingAnswer: App development pricing depends on scope and complexity. A simple MVP (minimal viable product) for a basic app can start from around $500. More complex apps—with custom features, backend, integrations, or advanced UI—cost more; we provide a detailed quote after discussing your requirements. We keep pricing competitive and transparent so you know what to expect.

faqWebsite.title: Website Development FAQ
faqWebsite.description: Questions and answers about our website development services and pricing.
faqWebsite.whatWeBuildAnswer: We build responsive websites, landing pages, and web applications. That includes marketing sites, product or campaign landing pages, multi-page sites, and web apps (e.g. dashboards, SaaS). We focus on fast load times, clear structure, and SEO so your site works well for users and search engines.
faqWebsite.processQuestion: What does your website development process look like?
faqWebsite.processAnswer: We start with your goals and content, then design (wireframes and UI), development, testing, and launch. We can integrate a CMS or analytics and set up SEO. You get clear milestones and regular updates. Many sites are delivered in one or two phases depending on size.
faqWebsite.howLongQuestion: How long does a website project take?
faqWebsite.howLongAnswer: A simple landing page might take a few weeks; a larger site or web app can take several weeks to a few months. We give you an estimate after discussing your requirements and can often deliver in phases (e.g. landing first, then rest of site).
faqWebsite.websitePricingQuestion: How much does website development cost?
faqWebsite.websitePricingAnswer: Website pricing depends on scope and complexity. A simple landing page can start from around $150 and go up with more pages, design work, and features (e.g. forms, CMS, integrations). Multi-page sites and web apps are quoted individually. We keep pricing competitive and transparent—contact us with your needs for a detailed quote.
